name: socialcredit
title: Social Credit
blurb: a Bluesky reputation leaderboard, separate from likes and reposts: sign in with Bluesky OAuth, paste any handle, give them +1 or -1 for their takes/actions/behavior. scores persist globally, tied to DIDs so handle changes don't lose history. one vote per account per hour, no self-voting, all enforced server-side off a live Jetstream feed — not trusted from the client. built for @fromthewestmeadow.com.
